body:
OBSERVED 2026-09-25 by the #2207 real-upgrade gate (leg F, state/kobo-upgrade-2207/REAL-UPGRADE-GATE.md):
book 5 was deleted with `calibredb remove` on the live library, as Calibre desktop would. The
first view pruned its 4 Downloads rows, but no Kobo was ever told: the emulator audit shows
`extra=1` on K1-K4 after every later sync.

Mechanism (code-read on main d065c8767): the only removals Kobo sync sends are
`KoboDeletedBook` tombstones. They are written by an in-app delete, a duplicate merge, and the
admin's stranded-book reconciliation (admin.py `kobo_reconcile`, which needs an uploaded
KoboReader.sqlite). Nothing notices a book that vanished from metadata.db by another route, so
the Kobo keeps a book the library no longer has. The book cannot be re-downloaded from the
device, and the per-device entitlement ledger keeps a row for it forever.

No user report here or upstream (searched 2026-09-26).

FIX SHAPE, which must not become a mass-removal hazard (a Changed/removed entitlement on a held
book is the #1925 class inverted, and an IsRemoved + IsHiddenFromArchive tombstone deletes the
book and its reading position from the device):
- Candidates: per-device ledger rows (`kobo_device_book_entitlement.book_id`) or `KoboSyncedBooks`
  uuids whose book is absent from metadata.db UNFILTERED. A book hidden by restrictions,
  shelf-only sync or a member library is not deleted and must never qualify.
- Persistence: tombstone only after the absence has been observed on two reads separated by
  time, with the first observation recorded. That covers a metadata.db being swapped, a mount
  that is briefly empty, or a library path being reconfigured.
- Circuit breaker: if more than a small count or fraction of a user's synced books are absent at
  once, write nothing. Log an ERROR and surface it to the admin instead; a library that lost
  everything is an outage, not a deletion.
- A uuid that reappears must clear its pending observation. It must also never be tombstoned
  while present, including a uuid Calibre re-created on re-import.
- Proof needs an emulator gate like #2207's: a calibredb delete removes the book from every
  Kobo exactly once; an unmounted or empty library and a restricted user remove nothing.
title: A book deleted outside the app is never removed from Kobos
